_readme: This file contains working examples of every configuration type in Mayuvgam. Use it alongside AI_INSTRUCTIONS.md and your current bundle (downloaded from Builder). All keys starting with _ are comments and are ignored by the uploader.
entities/example_full_entity.yaml:
entity:
  name: project
  label: "פרויקט"
  label_plural: "פרויקטים"
  icon: folder

fields:
  - name: title
    label: "כותרת"
    type: string
    required: true
    max_length: 200

  - name: description
    label: "תיאור"
    type: textarea
    rows: 4

  - name: status
    label: "סטטוס"
    type: picklist
    options:
      - value: open
        label: "פתוח"
      - value: in_progress
        label: "בעבודה"
      - value: closed
        label: "סגור"
    default: open

  - name: priority
    label: "עדיפות"
    type: picklist
    options:
      - value: low
        label: "נמוכה"
      - value: medium
        label: "בינונית"
      - value: high
        label: "גבוהה"
    default: medium

  - name: budget
    label: "תקציב"
    type: currency
    currency: ILS

  - name: quantity
    label: "כמות"
    type: number
    min: 0
    max: 9999

  - name: website
    label: "אתר"
    type: url

  - name: contact_email
    label: "אימייל"
    type: email

  - name: phone
    label: "טלפון"
    type: phone

  - name: start_date
    label: "תאריך התחלה"
    type: date

  - name: created_at_time
    label: "נוצר בשעה"
    type: datetime

  - name: client_ref
    label: "לקוח"
    type: relation
    relation_entity: account
    display_field: name
forms/example_two_column_form.yaml:
form:
  name: project_main
  entity: project
  label: "טופס פרויקט"
  is_default: true

sections:
  - title: "פרטים כלליים"
    columns: 2
    fields:
      - field: title
        width: 12
      - field: status
        width: 6
      - field: priority
        width: 6
      - field: client_ref
        width: 12

  - title: "כספים ותאריכים"
    columns: 2
    fields:
      - field: budget
        width: 6
      - field: quantity
        width: 6
      - field: start_date
        width: 6

  - title: "פרטי קשר"
    columns: 1
    fields:
      - field: contact_email
        width: 6
      - field: phone
        width: 6
      - field: website
        width: 12

  - title: "תיאור"
    columns: 1
    fields:
      - field: description
        width: 12

related_lists:
  - entity: task
    label: "משימות"
    view: task_list
views/example_table_view.yaml:
view:
  name: all_projects
  label: "כל הפרויקטים"
  entity: project
  type: table
  is_default: true

columns:
  - field: title
    width: 280
    display: link
  - field: status
    width: 140
    display: badge
    color_map:
      open: green
      in_progress: blue
      closed: gray
  - field: priority
    width: 110
    display: badge
    color_map:
      low: gray
      medium: yellow
      high: red
  - field: budget
    width: 130
    display: currency
  - field: start_date
    width: 120
    display: date
  - field: client_ref
    width: 180
    display: link

sort:
  - field: start_date
    direction: desc

pagination:
  page_size: 25
views/example_kanban_view.yaml:
view:
  name: project_kanban
  label: "לוח קנבן"
  entity: project
  type: kanban
  is_default: false

kanban_field: status
kanban_columns:
  - open
  - in_progress
  - closed

columns:
  - field: title
    display: link
  - field: priority
    display: badge
    color_map:
      low: gray
      medium: yellow
      high: red
  - field: budget
    display: currency
views/example_calendar_view.yaml:
view:
  name: project_calendar
  label: "לוח שנה"
  entity: project
  type: calendar
  is_default: false

calendar_date_field: start_date

columns:
  - field: title
    display: link
  - field: status
    display: badge
permissions/example_manager_role.yaml:
role:
  name: manager
  label: "מנהל"

permissions:
  project:
    read: all
    create: true
    update: all
    delete: own
  account:
    read: all
    create: true
    update: all
    delete: none
permissions/example_rep_role.yaml:
role:
  name: rep
  label: "נציג"

permissions:
  project:
    read: own
    create: true
    update: own
    delete: none
  account:
    read: team
    create: true
    update: own
    delete: none
workflows/example_on_create.yaml:
schema_version: "1.0.0"
entity: project
name: notify_on_create
enabled: true
priority: 100

trigger:
  type: on_create

actions:
  - type: set_field
    target: status
    value: open
  - type: send_notification
    channel: email
    to: "{{created_by.email}}"
    template: project_created
  - type: notify_user
    title: "פרויקט נוצר"
    message: "הפרויקט {{title}} נפתח בהצלחה"
    variant: success
workflows/example_on_update.yaml:
schema_version: "1.0.0"
entity: project
name: on_status_closed
enabled: true
priority: 50

trigger:
  type: on_update

conditions:
  operator: AND
  rules:
    - field: status
      op: equals
      value: closed
    - field: budget
      op: greater_than
      value: 0

actions:
  - type: calculate
    target: final_total
    formula: "{{quantity}} * {{budget}}"
  - type: call_webhook
    url: "https://hooks.example.com/project-closed"
    method: POST
    headers:
      Content-Type: application/json
    body:
      project_id: "{{id}}"
      title: "{{title}}"
      closed_by: "{{updated_by}}"
workflows/example_on_field_change.yaml:
schema_version: "1.0.0"
entity: project
name: toggle_fields_by_type
enabled: true
priority: 100

trigger:
  type: on_field_change
  fields:
    - priority

conditions:
  field: priority
  op: equals
  value: high

actions:
  - type: set_field_required
    required: true
    fields:
      - contact_email
      - phone
  - type: notify_user
    title: "עדיפות גבוהה"
    message: "חובה למלא פרטי קשר עבור פרויקטים בעדיפות גבוהה"
    variant: warning
workflows/example_before_save_validate.y:
schema_version: "1.0.0"
entity: project
name: validate_budget
enabled: true
priority: 10

trigger:
  type: before_save

actions:
  - type: validate
    condition:
      field: budget
      op: less_than
      value: 0
    errorMessage: "התקציב לא יכול להיות שלילי"
  - type: validate
    condition:
      operator: AND
      rules:
        - field: status
          op: equals
          value: closed
        - field: budget
          op: is_empty
    errorMessage: "לא ניתן לסגור פרויקט ללא תקציב"
workflows/example_after_save_webhook.yam:
schema_version: "1.0.0"
entity: project
name: sync_to_external
enabled: true
priority: 200

trigger:
  type: after_save

actions:
  - type: call_webhook
    url: "https://api.external-system.com/sync"
    method: PUT
    headers:
      Authorization: "Bearer SECRET"
      Content-Type: application/json
    body:
      id: "{{id}}"
      title: "{{title}}"
      status: "{{status}}"
workflows/example_on_form_load.yaml:
schema_version: "1.0.0"
entity: project
name: form_visibility_rules
enabled: true
priority: 100

trigger:
  type: on_form_load

actions:
  - type: set_field_visibility
    visible: false
    fields:
      - internal_notes
      - admin_code
workflows/example_on_delete.yaml:
schema_version: "1.0.0"
entity: project
name: audit_delete
enabled: true
priority: 100

trigger:
  type: on_delete

actions:
  - type: call_webhook
    url: "https://audit.example.com/deleted"
    method: POST
    body:
      entity: project
      record_id: "{{id}}"
      deleted_by: "{{updated_by}}"
workflows/example_complex_conditions.yam:
schema_version: "1.0.0"
entity: project
name: complex_alert
enabled: true
priority: 75

trigger:
  type: on_update

conditions:
  operator: AND
  rules:
    - field: status
      op: not_equals
      value: closed
    - field: start_date
      op: is_not_empty
    - operator: OR
      rules:
        - field: priority
          op: equals
          value: high
        - operator: AND
          rules:
            - field: budget
              op: greater_or_equal
              value: 50000
            - field: status
              op: in
              value:
                - open
                - in_progress

actions:
  - type: send_notification
    channel: in_app
    to: "{{owner_id.email}}"
    template: urgent_alert
workflows/example_run_workflow.yaml:
schema_version: "1.0.0"
entity: project
name: chain_to_followup
enabled: true
priority: 100

trigger:
  type: on_create

actions:
  - type: run_workflow
    workflow_id: "abc123-real-id-from-db"
    workflow_name: "זרימת מעקב (לתצוגה בלבד)"
email_templates/example_welcome.yaml:
email_template: name: welcome_email label: "מייל ברוך הבא" subject: "ברוך הבא, {{company_name}}!" body_html: |

שלום {{contact_name}},

תודה שנרשמת למערכת.

פרטי החשבון שלך:

  • חברה: {{company_name}}
  • סטטוס: {{status}}

לכל שאלה פנו אלינו.
email_templates/example_status_change.ya:
email_template: name: status_changed label: "עדכון סטטוס" subject: "עדכון סטטוס: {{title}} — {{status}}" body_html: |

שלום,

סטטוס הרשומה {{title}} שונה ל: {{status}}.

עודכן על ידי: {{updated_by}}
